name: Sean Strickland

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (73 in height, 76 in reach); 185 lb at the UFC 328 weigh-in (May 2026)

photo_coverage: Good. All three ESPN files were uploaded in May 2026 (after UFC 328, holding the belt), plus a Feb 2026 press frontal, a Feb 2026 three-quarter, a May 2026 profile and two freely licensed 2022 Commons stills (MMAnytt).

face.shape: Square to rectangular, with a broad, heavy lower face. The forehead is tall and the skull is long, with a flat back to the crown.
face.jaw: Wide, square and muscular, with pronounced jaw angles; the jaw line is almost horizontal from the angle to the chin
face.cheekbones: Moderately defined; the cheeks below are lean
face.brow_ridge: Heavy and prominent. The brows sit low on it, shading the eyes.
face.forehead: Tall and broad, with horizontal creases; small marks and abrasions after fights (Feb 2026 press photo)

eyes.shape: Small-medium, deep-set and slightly hooded; the outer corners droop slightly, giving a squinting look
eyes.colour: hazel: olive green-brown in the Feb 2026 press photo (01); the warm ESPN grade makes the iris read amber-brown, so do not render it as plain brown or as green

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, nearly horizontal, with a slight inner lift when talking

nose.tip: Broad, bulbous and rounded, often reddish
nose.fight_damage: The nose looks thickened and slightly flattened (wide bridge, broad tip), consistent with past breaks. ESPN has a clip titled 'Du Plessis breaks Strickland's nose' from their Feb 2025 rematch, and the nose was swollen and bloodied after UFC 328 (May 2026).

face.mouth_lips: Medium-wide mouth with a thin upper lip and a slightly fuller lower lip. Often talking or half-smiling in press photos; neutral is a straight, slightly downturned line.

ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes. Both ears show thickened, lumpy helix and upper ear (cauliflower), especially visible in the ESPN and Commons frontals.
ears.note: The ears also stick out from the head

face.notable_marks_scars: Fight scabs and marks on the forehead and eyebrows in the 2026 photos; redness over the nose and cheeks

hair.style: Very short buzz cut, close to shaved (about 2 to 3 mm in 2026; slightly longer, about 5 mm, in 2022)
hair.colour_note: Light brown/sandy, so the buzz reads as a faint brown tint over pale scalp (scalp sample #6c4847 includes skin). The colour comes from the longer 2022 buzz.
hair.hairline: Slightly receded at the temples; high forehead

facial_hair.detail: Light stubble about 1 to 3 mm in most photos (ESPN May 2026); a slightly fuller short stubble-beard at the UFC 328 weigh-in. Clean-shaven at times (2022).
facial_hair.colour_note: Light brown with a ginger tinge (chin sample #8c5b57 includes skin)
facial_hair.shape: full-face stubble following the jaw and upper lip

skin.tone_hex_method: average of the cheek samples only (forehead samples sit on specular highlights in every photo); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma percentile pixels of the patch
skin.undertone: Pink / ruddy. Fair skin that reddens easily, with a visibly redder nose and cheeks.
skin.freckles_marks: Redness on the nose and cheeks; fight marks on the forehead and brows; light body hair across the chest, abdomen, arms and legs.
skin.note: Samples agree well across studio, press and video light (cheeks #b2836f to #d1918e). Use a fair skin with a pink undertone and add redness to the nose and cheeks.

body.build: Lean, wiry-athletic middleweight (185 cm, 84 kg) with long arms (193 cm reach)
body.body_fat_note: The ab outline is visible but not deeply cut; the build is smooth rather than bodybuilder-defined
body.chest: Medium pectorals covered in dense light-brown chest hair that runs down the midline of the abdomen
body.arms: Long, sinewy, moderately muscled; hairy forearms
body.legs_calves: Long legs with lean thighs; slim calves; noticeable leg hair
body.posture: Upright with slightly rounded shoulders and a slight forward head carriage
body.notable: Body hair (chest, abdomen, arms, legs) is a defining trait for him; render it as a texture.

tattoos.description: No tattoos visible in the May 2026 ESPN cutouts, the press photos or the fight photos

kit.fight_shorts: White Venum shorts with STRICKLAND in red down the leg (UFC 328, May 2026; also UFC Houston Feb 2026); black/gold champion shorts with Monster and crypto.com logos (ESPN May 2026)

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set. They are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs.

morphs_unavailable: No ear targets at all in the shipped manifest, and no cauliflower target in any set. The large protruding cauliflower ears need a custom ear sculpt, a scale on the ear vertices, or at least a normal map (full-set stand-in values under morphs_if_available). No nose-damage target beyond width and tip. No body-hair control, so do it in the texture.
notes: Confidence: high for the overall look (square heavy jaw, near-shaved sandy buzz, heavy low brow, deep-set hazel eyes, broad damaged nose, protruding cauliflower ears, fair ruddy skin, hairy lean build, no tattoos); medium for morph values. What to watch for: (1) the ears are a key cue: large, protruding and cauliflowered on both sides; (2) the nose is broad and fleshy, not narrow or straight; (3) do not give him tattoos; (4) keep the build lean and wiry, not bulky; (5) macro/heightUpM uses a linear fit to the two MPFB2 builds in research/assets.md (height slider 0.30 -> 1.61 m, 0.62 -> 1.89 m, so slider = 0.5 + (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 and heightUpM = 2 * (slider - 0.5)). Muscle and weight also change stature slightly, so measure the built mesh and nudge heightUpM until it matches the listed height. Review (second pass, 2026-11-06): re-checked every photo; the description holds up (near-shaved buzz, light stubble, cauliflower ears on both sides, broad fleshy nose, body hair, no tattoos visible anywhere in the cutouts or fight photos). Eye colour wording tightened (olive hazel, amber-looking under the ESPN grade). Commons licences re-checked: Sean_Strickland_2022.jpg is CC BY 3.0 and Sean_Strickland_at_UFN_200.png is CC BY-SA 4.0 (both MMAnytt). Morph names and ranges validated against assets/embed/mh-manifest.json; values unchanged.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/sean-strickland.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn_stance_left.png, espn_stance_right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Philly-shell style: bladed, lead hand low across the body, rear glove high by the chin, chin behind the lead shoulder, walks forward behind the jab.
